card.name: "at" after lab monitoring instructions
card.fires_on: The word "at" right after a lab test or measurement to be obtained, such as complete blood count, liver tests or ECG. It introduces the timing, such as baseline or each cycle.

modes.label: Lab monitoring at baseline
modes.description: "at" after an instruction to obtain or monitor blood counts or chemistries, before baseline or cycle timing.
modes.example: Obtain complete blood counts (CBC)<< at>> baseline and periodically during treatment.

modes.label: Measurements taken at time points
modes.description: "at" after a past-tense report that assessments or measurements were done, before listed times.
modes.example: Electrocardiogram (ECG) measurements were taken<< at>> various time points during the asenap

card.writes: It slightly favors words like "manipulated" and "exclusion" and suppresses "proxy"; this is not clearly tied to the pattern.
